item.title: Group of Ski Moms, Including One From SF and One From Marin, Among 9 Avalanche Victims
item.description: A group of mothers of students at Sugar Bowl Academy, a boarding school for competitive skiers, was part of the three-day back-country skiing expedition that ended in tragedy on Tuesday.

item.title: Mother and Son Found Dead With Multiple Gunshot Wounds In Pleasanton
item.description: A mother and son were both found dead inside a Pleasanton home on Wednesday, and the circumstances of their deaths remains unclear.

item.title: Lurie Moves Ahead With ‘RESET’ Center Drug Sobering Facility, Even as City Attorney Questions Its Legality
item.description: Mayor Lurie signed a new drug-focused sobering center into law Wednesday, despite City Attorney pushback that the center has a “failure to comply with State law” and “non-compliance with standards for detention facilities.”

item.title: Suspect Who Stole Mayor Barbara Lee's SUV Had Been Camping Inside City Hall For Three Days
item.description: The still at-large suspect in the theft of Oakland Mayor Barbara Lee's city-owned transport vehicle apparently spent all of President's Day weekend camped out inside City Hall.

item.title: Meta Team Scolded For Wearing Those Ray-Ban Glasses In Court During Zuckerberg Testimony
item.description: The team attending the Los Angeles trial where Meta and YouTube execs are being tried for allegedly making their products more addictive to children to support CEO Mark Zuckerberg showed up, in the way of tech douches, wearing those Ray-Ban Meta glasses that double as video recording devices.

item.title: Heads Up: BART Delays of 20-30 Minutes Expected Saturday Night as Crews Do Maintenance on the Transbay Tube
item.description: While the Saturday night BART delays are not expected to kick in until 10 pm, late-night Saturday BART riders should bring a book or something, as trains in the Transbay Tube will be delayed by at least 20 or 30 minutes.

item.title: Ninth Circuit Courthouse Security Officer Shot and Wounded Man With Knife
item.description: We're now learning of a shooting incident that happened last month at a federal courthouse in San Francisco in which a security officer shot a man four times.

item.title: The Wait Is Ending! Bay Lights Will Officially Be Re-Lit on Friday, March 20
item.description: Our three-year-long regional loss of the beloved Bay Lights is finally coming to an end, as the lights will be officially re-lit and razzle-dazzling the Bay Bridge again on Friday, March 20.

item.title: K-Pop Mega-Star RM of BTS Is Getting an Art Exhibition at SFMOMA This Coming October
item.description: Run BTS fans run, as 200 works from the personal collection of BTS rapper and songwriter RM are coming to the SFMOMA this October, in the only gallery display the South Korean pop superstar will have in the US.

item.title: Day Around the Bay: Richmond’s Own Alysa Liu Wins Figure Skating Gold, Bay Area Loses Its Mind
item.description: They caught the guy who allegedly stole Oakland Mayor Barbara Lee’s SUV; Yosemite National Park is totally closed because of extreme winter weather; and Richmond’s Alysa Liu won the Women's Single Skating gold medal.
